title: Changing a permit
rule: The holder can apply to change a permit. The Director or forest manager can also propose a change if circumstances have changed.
points: The holder has 30 days to accept or reject a proposed change.
If rejected, they negotiate for 60 days.
Then the proposal is withdrawn or a notice takes effect at least one month later.
If the change disadvantages the holder significantly, they may ask for reduced payments or surrender the permit.
